mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,recipient_id,channel,server_id,address,enabled,version,updated_by,created_at,updated_at FROM notification_recipient_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} ORDER BY recipient_id ASC, channel ASC
SELECT DISTINCT channel, server_id FROM notification_recipient_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND enabled=TRUE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM notification_recipient_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id}
